title: Transfer Music
heading: Bring Your Music In
instructions: Enter the pairing code shown in iMusic. Keep the Wi-Fi Transfer page open, and use a trusted local network.
wrongCode: The pairing code is incorrect or too many attempts were made. Restart uploads in iMusic.
expired: Pairing expired. Pair again to continue.
drop: Drop audio files here, or choose files to upload.
networkError: Connection lost. Keep Wi-Fi Transfer open in iMusic and try again.
tooLarge: This file exceeds the upload size limit.
results: Files received by iMusic are imported on your device. Check import results in the app.
privacy: Your files stay on your local network.
